figurative_meaning_en: Everyone from the neighborhood arrives or shows up
similar_in_english: Everyone and their dog shows up
example_sentences_in_bangla: বিয়ের অনুষ্ঠানে পাড়া ঝেঁটিয়ে আসা হয়েছে।
সভায় পাড়া ঝেঁটিয়ে আসার জন্য সবাই উপস্থিত ছিল।
example_sentences_in_english: The wedding ceremony had the whole neighborhood showing up.
The meeting saw everyone from the neighborhood turning out.
note: This idiom reflects the close-knit nature of Bengali neighborhoods, emphasizing communal participation.
